# Known bugs that GoogleSQL's compliance tests (`just compliance`) found. Each case gives
# BigQuery's answer after `!>`, which the emulator does not give yet: the case passes while the
# emulator answers otherwise. Every one of them is to be fixed; a fix fails its case, which then
# moves to the file of its function, written with `=>`.
#
# Inputs come from UNNEST so that the analyzer cannot fold the expression into a constant, which
# it evaluates correctly.
